text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—A tea party with the fans together, you 
say?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's right! There's a fan meetup event 
coming up, right? I was thinking we could 
host it there.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Spending tea time in a relaxing space 
together with your favorite horse girl. 
There's definitely going to be high demand 
among fans.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! I'll do it, I wanna do it! Ehehe, 
will we get to eat tons of sweets~?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, hold on, don't get too carried away 
with the snacks. The fans are coming to 
see us, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. For the sake of the fans who watch 
our races... let us prepare thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Loyce-san. If you please, kindly check 
over this list.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Equipment procurement, as well as 
ingredient management. I have compiled the 
tasks I should handle right here.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Efficient as always. Fufu, with this, the 
preparations will go smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa!! Look, look! Turbo made this!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Its name is the Rainbow Max Drink! It's 
1000% sweetness at full blast~! Let's put 
this on the menu, put it on the menu!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way! That doesn't fit a tea 
party at all. Normally it'd be black tea 
or something, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~!! Why, why-y-y!? Come on, Turbo wants 
to make it~!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I am in favor. I believe it is a wonderful 
idea that fits Turbo-san well.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Charging forward unbounded by common sense 
is Turbo-san's strength. Therefore, 
leveraging that direction would be the 
superior choice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
For instance, how about making it a daring 
original menu item? I am certain the fans 
will be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ohh~...! Hey, hey, Ikuno, Ikuno! Is there 
anything else Turbo can do!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
You always say it, right?! Tasks... was 
it? Teach Turbo about that too!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind, could you manage us as 
well?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
With Ikuno-san's administrative 
capabilities and our strengths combined, 
we'll be unbeatable! It will definitely 
bring out each of our charms!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Benissimo! My charms under Ikuno-san's 
baton... I wonder what kind of melody they 
will play.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Machitan's individuality is finally 
blooming...! Mmh mmh, please take good 
care of me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
M-My strength, huh~... Oh whatever, what 
will be, will be! Just do whatever you 
want!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Everyone... yes, leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Utilizing my management capabilities, I 
shall make this the ultimate event.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I heard the Tracen Academy horse girls 
were hosting a fan meetup. When I visited 
the venue to check on how things were 
going—

text_block_list.name: Turbo & Nature
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to the tea party~!! W-Welcome to 
the tea party~...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, look, look at our glasses! We're 
all matching♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a closer look, not just the horse 
girls, but all the visiting fans were 
wearing glasses too.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the concept for this event is— 
precisely, "An Extraordinary Experience 
Through Glasses"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By having both the horse girls and fans 
wear glasses, we provide a unique 
experiential value unlike the everyday... 
Fufu, it's remarkably effective.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It went just as Loyce-san envisioned. Your 
production was marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, we're the ones who should be 
thanking you. After all, it was Ikuno-san 
who drew out our true potential!

text_block_list.name: Machitan Fan
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat!? Machitan-chan, you made all the 
sweets on this menu yourself!? I'm so 
happy, but wasn't that super tough...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! I baked them bit by bit 
during my free time, so it was a total 
breeze~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Actually~... it's all thanks to Ikuno 
reviewing my daily schedule for me! Man, 
she's just so reliable, isn't she?

text_block_list.name: Earth Fan
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! This music playing right now is so 
calming, isn't it? The sound is so crystal 
clear...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You noticed? Splendid. I wanted us to 
spend a dreamlike time together, so I was 
quite particular about the music.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The acoustics, for instance. It's all 
thanks to my brilliant friend who drew up 
a list of available audio equipment for 
me... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Look, everyone is completely captivated. 
Bringing smiles to our fans' faces—that is 
your doing, Ikuno-san.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I am honored. It is our proud tea 
party, after all.
